invariants.rule: highest-priority impact signal must-not be overridden by no-doc-impact
invariants.positive_case: contract-impact classification wins when any higher-priority evidence is present
invariants.negative_case: a formatting or no-doc-impact claim hides an API, schema, lifecycle, or behavior change

invariants.rule: task-local design must-not substitute missing project-current SSOT
invariants.positive_case: project-current source is discovered through explicit config or a version-selected manifest
invariants.negative_case: a historical or task-local design package is labeled project-current

invariants.rule: missing module/symbol/test evidence must-not be marked covered
invariants.positive_case: trace remains pending until current code and test evidence digests exist
invariants.negative_case: planning prose alone changes a trace row to covered or done

invariants.rule: Custom-v2 consistency must-not require mutating/falling back to legacy v1 or misclassify pinned debt as green/SDK-ready
invariants.positive_case: exact inventory and failure fingerprints classify known debt non-green while Core-zero, v2 closure and no-fallback E2E pass
invariants.negative_case: a count-only waiver, changed legacy failure, Core edit, runtime fallback or SDK-ready claim is accepted

invariants.rule: applicable TTFC, first-verified, terminal time, canonical context bytes and provider total input tokens must each independently meet warm/cold <=0.70
invariants.positive_case: every applicable live median ratio passes
invariants.negative_case: an average or model-cycle substitute hides one regression

invariants.rule: a baseline below floor or fewer than five valid live pairs must-not produce a relative pass
invariants.negative_case: tiny denominator or partial sample is marketed as saving

invariants.rule: any hard budget, drift, trace, official-install or unapply failure must-not release
invariants.positive_case: all current deterministic and live release invariants are green
invariants.negative_case: unit tests override a red end-to-end invariant

invariants.rule: live metrics must include provider-adapter provenance, explicit cached-input semantics, uncached/cached/output/total tokens, actual/duplicate reads, cache hits and model/tool/wait counters without unknown-as-zero substitution
invariants.positive_case: raw capture normalizes every mandatory metric and digest
invariants.negative_case: prose, aggregate-only telemetry or missing cache/read semantics is accepted

invariants.rule: avoidable Gate-caused active time, total token cost and model cycles must each remain strictly below ten percent with useful findings, false positives and semantic changes attributed independently
invariants.positive_case: all three known ratios are below 0.10 and semantic-change pairs restart
invariants.negative_case: ratios are averaged, unknown is zero, useful defects are false positives or semantic change shrinks only numerator

invariants.rule: recorded or synthetic evidence and live schedules exceeding the global cap must-not masquerade as a real five-pair current provider proof
invariants.positive_case: two live fixtures complete five pairs within cap and CI traces remain labeled non-live
invariants.negative_case: recorded trace is called live, pair count is reduced or provider calls continue past cap/blocker
